Perfect! All 26 tests pass. I've created the invoicing module with:

**`src/invoices.js`** — `createInvoice()` function that:
- Validates the customer exists (returns `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND` if not)
- Validates `issueDate` is a real date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (returns `DATE_INVALID` otherwise)
- Validates `lines` array is not empty (returns `NO_LINES` if empty)
- Validates each line has a positive integer `qty` (returns `QTY_INVALID` otherwise)
- Validates each SKU exists in the catalogue (returns `UNKNOWN_SKU` if not)
- Returns an invoice with enriched lines: `name`, `unitPrice`, and `vatRate` are copied from the catalogue
- Status is always `'draft'`

**`src/errors.js`** — Added three new error codes: `DATE_INVALID`, `NO_LINES`, `QTY_INVALID`

**`test/invoices.test.js`** — 13 tests covering all success and error cases, including validation of input immutability and VAT rates.
